text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when fixes are simple and cheap. This saves time and money later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing: team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve overall team quality, because everyone follows shared standards and gives helpful feedback. Although reviews take some time, they are a wise investment. In short, code reviews make software safer, teams stronger, and products better.
